title: Credentia
features: private and public content visibility rules

bottomTabBar.note: 5 tabs, rounded outline icons: home/feed, search, chat-bubble, bell, user-circle. Active tab in accent, others neutral grey.

sharedComponents.statusBar: top app bar: back chevron (detail screens) or app wordmark (tab roots) + verified-badge icon where relevant
sharedComponents.controls: primary button: pill, accentFill bg, white label, default/pressed/disabled. secondary button: pill, 1px border accent, accent label. text input: 12px radius, border default, accent ring on focus, danger ring + helper text on error. card: 20px radius, soft shadow. chip: pill, accentTint bg for filters, neutral bg for tags.

screens.name: onboarding-welcome
screens.purpose: brand splash introducing the professional network for dental and healthcare professionals
screens.content: logo mark, headline 'The trusted network for healthcare professionals', subhead mentioning verified credentials, illustration of connected professional avatars, Get Started + Log In pill buttons

screens.name: signup-role-select
screens.purpose: new user picks their professional role during registration
screens.content: step indicator 1/3, grid of role cards (Dentist, Dental Hygienist, Dental Assistant, Orthodontist, More specialties), email + password fields, Continue button

screens.name: credential-verification
screens.purpose: user uploads license/credential documents for identity verification before full access
screens.content: step indicator 2/3, license number field, state/board dropdown, document upload card (drag license photo or PDF), NPI number field, note 'Reviewed within 1-2 business days', Submit for Review button

screens.name: login
screens.content: email field, password field with show/hide, Forgot password link, Log In pill button, divider 'or continue with', Google/Apple buttons, link to sign up

screens.name: feed-home
screens.purpose: primary home feed of posts and updates from the user's professional network
screens.content: top bar with wordmark + verified badge + bell icon, story-style row of connection avatars, feed of post cards (author avatar + name + credential badge + specialty tag, post text, optional image, like/comment/share row), floating create-post button

screens.name: post-detail
screens.purpose: view a single post with full comment thread
screens.content: full post card at top, comment list with avatars + timestamps, reply input pinned at bottom, overflow menu (report, save, share)

screens.name: create-post
screens.purpose: compose a new post and choose its visibility
screens.content: modal sheet, text composer, attach photo/document icons, visibility selector chips (Public / Connections only / Private), Post button top right

screens.name: discover-search
screens.purpose: search and filter for other verified professionals
screens.content: search bar, filter chips (Specialty, Location, Rating, Verified only), scrollable list of professional result cards with avatar, name, specialty, city, star rating, Connect button

screens.name: professional-profile
screens.purpose: view another professional's public profile, credentials, and ratings
screens.content: cover banner + avatar + verified-credential badge, name, specialty, location pin, bio, stats row (connections, years experience, rating average with star breakdown), recent reviews list, Connect / Message buttons

screens.name: my-profile
screens.purpose: the signed-in user's own profile with stats and quick actions
screens.content: cover banner + avatar + verified badge, name + specialty, stats row (connections, posts, rating), Edit Profile button, tabbed sections (Posts, Credentials, Reviews), Settings gear icon

screens.name: edit-profile
screens.purpose: edit personal and professional profile fields with per-field visibility
screens.content: avatar upload, name, specialty dropdown, bio textarea, license info section (read-only, verified lock icon), per-field visibility toggle (Public/Connections/Private) next to sensitive fields, Save button

screens.name: messages-inbox
screens.purpose: list of direct message conversations with peers
screens.content: search field, list of conversation rows (avatar, name, credential badge, last message preview, timestamp, unread dot)

screens.name: chat-thread
screens.purpose: one to one direct message conversation
screens.content: header with peer avatar + name + specialty, message bubbles (sent accent, received neutral), attachment icon, text input with send button

screens.name: notifications
screens.content: grouped list (Today, This week) of notification rows with icon by type (connection request, comment, like, verification approved, admin alert), tap targets, mark-all-read link

screens.name: report-content
screens.purpose: report or flag a post, comment, or user for moderation
screens.content: modal sheet, reason radio list (Spam, Harassment, Misinformation, Impersonation, Other), optional detail textarea, Submit Report button

screens.name: admin-dashboard
screens.purpose: basic administrative view for reviewing verifications and moderation queue
screens.content: summary stat cards (Pending verifications, Open reports, Active users), tabbed queue list (Verification requests with approve/reject buttons; Reported content with review/remove/dismiss actions)

screens.name: privacy-settings
screens.purpose: manage visibility and permission rules across the account
screens.content: grouped setting rows: profile visibility, content default visibility, who can message me, who can see my location, blocked users link, data & privacy policy link

designSystem.spacing: 8pt scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32); screen edge padding 20px; generous vertical rhythm
designSystem.elevation: soft only: card = 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04) + 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.06); no hard/black shadows
designSystem.icons: one set, rounded outline (Lucide/Phosphor regular), 24px, ~1.75 stroke
designSystem.a11y: white labels only on accentFill (>=4.5:1); bright accent for large fills/icons/hero numerals with dark label (>=3:1); text on gradient passes 4.5:1; tap targets >=44x44pt
